# JPEG fixture site (M17)

Committed fixture site for the M17 JPEG support tests. It is served from `file://`
only, needs no network, display or installed font, and is asserted by
`shell.jpeg` and `shell.jpeg_dump_boxes`.

The JPEG/PNG files themselves live in `tests/fixtures/images/` (owned by the
render module, generated by `tests/fixtures/images/generate_jpeg.cpp`) and are
referenced from here through `../images/`, so this site contains no binary data.
The JPEG fixtures are encoded at quality 100 with 1x1 sampling (no chroma
subsampling), and JPEG is lossy, so tests compare decoded pixels with a
documented tolerance: **every channel within 8** of the nominal value below.
The PNG fixtures stay exact.

## Files

`index.html` — six rows, one image each (the mixed row has two):

- `#rgb` -> `../images/jpeg_rgb_16x8.jpg`, intrinsic 16x8. Decoded content:
  four 8x4 quadrants (top-left red `#ff0000`, top-right green `#00ff00`,
  bottom-left blue `#0000ff`, bottom-right white `#ffffff`).
- `#gray` -> `../images/jpeg_gray_16x8.jpg`, intrinsic 16x8. Decoded content:
  four 8x4 quadrants with gray levels 0, 64, 128, 255.
- `#progressive` -> `../images/jpeg_progressive_16x8.jpg`, CSS
  `#scaled { width: 32px }`, so the box is 32x16 (intrinsic 2:1 ratio). Same
  quadrants as `#rgb`; the stream is progressive.
- `#mixed` -> `../images/flag_16x8.png` + `../images/jpeg_rgb_16x8.jpg`,
  two 16x8 boxes. The PNG columns 0-7 are red and 8-15 blue (exact); the JPEG
  shows the same quadrants as `#rgb`.
- `#missing` -> `missing.jpg` (no file): skipped.
- `#truncated` -> `../images/jpeg_truncated_16x8.jpg`: skipped (the entropy-coded
  scan is cut in half; the decoder must reject it as an ordinary error).

The truncated fixture is `jpeg_rgb_16x8.jpg` cut in the middle of its scan, so
its header is complete but the data ends early: the decoder must reject it as an
ordinary error. A broken/missing JPEG behaves exactly like a broken PNG — the
image is skipped silently (no box, no pixels, no stderr) and the page still
loads.

## Expected computed values and box geometry

Viewport 320x400, built-in bitmap font path (empty `FONTCONFIG_FILE` config), UA
body margin 8 px and UA `p` margins 16 px 0 → rows start at y = 24, 72, 120, 168,
216, 264 (16 px line each).

```
<p id="rgb">         block x=8 y=24  width=304 height=16
  <img> inline x=8 y=24 width=16 height=8
  text "RGB" x=32 y=24 width=24 height=16        text "photo" x=64 y=24 width=40 height=16
<p id="gray">        block x=8 y=72  width=304 height=16
  <img> inline x=8 y=72 width=16 height=8
  text "Gray" x=32 y=72 width=32 height=16       text "photo" x=72 y=72 width=40 height=16
<p id="progressive"> block x=8 y=120 width=304 height=16
  <img> inline x=8 y=120 width=32 height=16
  text "Progressive" x=48 y=120 width=88 height=16   text "photo" x=144 y=120 width=40 height=16
<p id="mixed">       block x=8 y=168 width=304 height=16
  <img> inline x=8 y=168 width=16 height=8       (PNG flag)
  <img> inline x=24 y=168 width=16 height=8      (JPEG rgb)
  text "Mixed" x=48 y=168 width=40 height=16     text "formats" x=96 y=168 width=56 height=16
<p id="missing">     block x=8 y=216 width=304 height=16
  text "Missing" x=8 y=216 width=56 height=16    text "JPEG" x=72 y=216 width=32 height=16
<p id="truncated">   block x=8 y=264 width=304 height=16
  text "Truncated" x=8 y=264 width=72 height=16  text "JPEG" x=88 y=264 width=32 height=16
```

The page content height is 304 CSS px (the `#missing` and `#truncated` rows keep
their text lines but no image box).

## Expected pixels

`--screenshot` at 320x400 (all decodable images are opaque; JPEG tolerance ±8 per
channel):

- `#rgb` 16x8 at (8,24): (10,25) red, (20,25) green, (10,29) blue, (20,29) white.
- `#gray` 16x8 at (8,72): (10,73) black, (20,73) 64 gray, (10,77) 128 gray,
  (20,77) white.
- `#progressive` scaled to 32x16 at (8,120): (10,121) red, (30,121) green,
  (10,131) blue, (30,131) white.
- `#mixed`: the PNG at (8,168) is exact — (10,169) `#ff0000`, (20,169)
  `#0000ff`; the JPEG at (24,168) shows (26,169) red, (36,169) green,
  (26,173) blue, (36,173) white.
- `#missing`/`#truncated`: no image pixels; their text ink is still painted.
